name: Cherry Blossom ~Saigo no Sakura ga Chiru Maeni~
original_name: Cherry Blossom ～最後の桜が散る前に～
source:
This is the story of Hibiki – a girl who turned to live like a social recluse, after she failed in the university she had applied (yet her friend DID).

Many years later as a steady OL, she reminisces on the period of time when she met the person who had changed her life (and helped her reconcile with said friend).

[taken from [url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/10/16/otome-game-review-cherry-blossom-saigo-no-sakura-ga-chiru-maeni-by-imitation-drug/]Koorin's blog[/url]]
translation:
这是谷户响的故事。报考大学落榜、朋友却顺利考上后，她开始闭门不出，与社会隔绝。

多年以后，已经成为稳定职业女性的响回忆起那段岁月。当时，她遇见一个改变自己人生的人，也在对方帮助下与那名朋友重归于好。

[摘自Koorin的[url=http://koorinokokoro.wordpress.com/2011/10/16/otome-game-review-cherry-blossom-saigo-no-sakura-ga-chiru-maeni-by-imitation-drug/]博客[/url]]
